import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

R = {'https://demo.test': 'r1'}

# large sid values, numeric sorting
big = 2**62 - 4
ev = (stream(big, base_fields(path='/big')) + stream(0, base_fields(path='/zero'))
      + stream(4, base_fields(path='/four')))
got = run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})
assert [s['sid'] for s in got['streams']] == [0, 4, big], got['streams']
assert got['streams'][2]['sid'] == big and got['streams'][2]['status'] == 'forwarded'
print('ok   large sid numeric sort')

# 256 pairs in one HEADERS section, near-limit sizes
pairs = [[':method','GET'], [':scheme','https'], [':authority','demo.test'], [':path','/']]
size = sum(len(n)+len(v)+32 for n,v in pairs)
per = (8192 - size) // 256
n = 250
extra = [['x-%04d' % i, 'v' * per] for i in range(n)]
tot = sum(len(a)+len(b)+32 for a,b in extra)
assert size + tot <= 8192, (size, tot)
ev = [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': pairs + extra}, {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]
assert run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
extra2 = extra + [['x-last', 'v' * (8192 - size - tot - 6)]]
ev = [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': pairs + extra2}, {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]
assert run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded'
ev = [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': pairs + extra2 + [['x-over','vv']]},
      {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]
assert run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected'
print('ok   254-pair section at the size boundary')

# 16 distinct origins, 64 routes
routes = {}
for i in range(16):
    routes['https://o%02d.test' % i] = 'origin-%02d' % i
for i in range(16):
    routes['http://o%02d.test' % i] = 'origin-%02d' % i
    routes['https://o%02d.test:8080' % i] = 'origin-%02d' % i
    routes['http://o%02d.test:8081' % i] = 'origin-%02d' % i
ev = []
for i in range(16):
    ev += stream(i*4, base_fields(scheme='http', authority='o%02d.test' % i, path='/h%d' % i))
    ev += stream(64 + i*4, base_fields(scheme='https', authority='o%02d.test' % i, path='/s%d' % i))
got = run({'routes': routes, 'events': ev})
assert len(got['origins']) == 16
assert all(s['status'] == 'forwarded' for s in got['streams'])
assert all(bytes.fromhex(v) for v in got['origins'].values())
print('ok   16 origins / 64 routes')

# duplicate cache keys from different streams
ev = (stream(0, base_fields(path='/same')) + stream(4, base_fields(path='/same')))
got = run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})
assert [s['status'] for s in got['streams']] == ['forwarded','forwarded']
assert got['streams'][0]['cache_key'] == got['streams'][1]['cache_key']
assert got['streams'][1]['offset'] == got['streams'][0]['length']
print('ok   duplicate cache keys')

# fin at last index
ev = [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 9, 'hex': ''}]
ev += stream(0, base_fields(path='/last'))
assert ev[-1]['type'] == 'fin'
got = run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})
assert got['streams'][0]['commit_at'] == len(ev) - 1
print('ok   commit_at index of fin event')

# empty-string data chunks and unknown frames between every frame
ev = ([{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 5, 'hex': ''}]
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': base_fields()}]
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 13, 'hex': ''}]
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'data', 'hex': ''}]
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 99, 'hex': ''}]
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': []}]
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}])
want = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n'
check('empties-everywhere', {'routes': R, 'events': ev}, None, {'r1': want})

# reset before anything / unknown only then reset
for ev in [[{'sid': 0, 'type': 'reset'}],
           [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 1, 'hex': 'aa'}, {'sid': 0, 'type': 'reset'}]]:
    assert run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})['streams'][0]['status'] == 'cancelled'
print('ok   reset variants')
